summary: Cello notes played through a computed cello body. Limits first: A3 and the low notes are too dark, several notes are too clean, and the stopped notes sit off pitch. The eight pages now playing are earlier renders, restored on 2026-11-10 under the owner's rule that a page changes only at or above the note's best count. None of the eight plays the measured outline of the 1697 Castelbarco cello, the cello bow's hair (0.605 m) at the measured speed (0.1662 m/s) and distance from the bridge (58.9 mm), ribs meshed in 24 layers, the radiating skin, the varnish film, the thermochemical air or the boundary-element f-hole neck; each sentence below that names one describes the page this restored render replaced, and each restored page's own text gives its own rows. Values the trial would have used, each named: the horsehair pack of Pitteroff and Woodhouse 1998 re-listed under temperature and angular-frequency validity ranges (the fibre rung queries a pack at the card's own state only) with the printed static modulus 7 GPa and density 1100 kg/m^3 and the pack's model viscosity 1.146e6 Pa s continued unchanged to the card's 1000 rad/s; the bending viscosity, not printed anywhere, set equal to the axial one; the bundle tension, not printed for a cello (15 N for 50 hairs, a uniform share of the violin's second-hand 60 N); 2 axial and 2 normal modes. Second refusal, with `bow_fiber_motion 1 1000 0.001 1048576` (the README's own limits), at the first moving-contact update, in smoke renders with the body cut to 8 modes (E3 on fix1 after 25 min, E2 on tip10 after 30 min, the same text on both): `moving friction exceeds max_update_terms`. That check counts 2 x (max(3 d^2, linked) x s + n x s^2) terms per update, with n the modes of the complete network, d = 2 n + material memory + radiation state, and s the ports plus obstacles; the limit a card can state is capped at 1,048,576. At the cards' 385 modes (256 body, 2 x 64 string, 1 cavity) d is at least 770 and the count is at least 3.56 million per unit of s, at least 3.39 times the cap with no memory, radiation or fibre states counted. A first form of the trial was also refused after 33 min by a held-coordinate check on the pack's frequency axis, which the re-listing removed. So the resolved hair bundle is not available to a cello card at this size without an engine change, and the in-cycle noise of the bowed cello stays unmodelled.
